finding.claim: Registry-controlled bearer realm, service, and scope receive the user's stored credentials (Basic auth or OAuth2 password grant) and the resulting token is returned to the registry. Trust-boundary decision, consistent with Docker's behavior, but not restricted to the registry's own domain.
finding.source: WWW-Authenticate params realm/service/scope on a 401 from the registry (challenge.go:67-132, read at client.go:310, 356-360)
finding.sink: fetchDistributionToken sends SetBasicAuth(username,password) to realm (client.go:422-424); fetchOAuth2Token sends password grant form (client.go:470-473); bearer token sent back to registry (client.go:369)

trace.note: server scope merged into requested scopes
fetchBearerToken invoked with realm and service
Basic credentials attached to request to realm host
returned token attached to retry request to registry

finding.guards_checked: Scheme must be http/https (client.go:225-234); http realm rejected when registry is https (229-230); private/loopback/link-local IP-literal realm rejected (235-242); Authorization stripped on cross-origin redirect (146-157); 401 ignored when challenge origin differs (304-306). NOT checked: realm host relation to registry domain; scope/service restriction to registry's own repos. Docs at client.go:205-216 state cross-host realms are intentional.

finding.claim: Blob and manifest Fetch return the response body without hashing it against the requested digest. The only digest check is the optional Docker-Content-Digest header, which is server-supplied and therefore provides no protection against a malicious registry.
finding.source: Response body from the registry for a digest or tag reference
finding.sink: Raw resp.Body returned to caller as content for target.Digest (repository.go:786 blob, 1154 manifest)

trace.note: Content-Length must equal target.Size when present
verifyContentDigest checks header only if present

finding.guards_checked: Content-Length match (772, 1148); manifest Content-Type match (1141-1147); optional Docker-Content-Digest header check (1684-1698). No body hash in this tree (grep for VerifyReader/Verifier/Digester found none). Upstream content-layer verification is not present in this tree, so exploitability depends on callers.

finding.claim: Token cache is process-global (DefaultCache) and keyed only by registry host plus scopes, not by identity. A client with no or different Credential function can be sent a bearer token obtained for another identity against the same host.
finding.source: Token stored by one Client using DefaultClient/DefaultCache for host H
finding.sink: Cached token attached as Authorization header to a request by a different Client (client.go:284-288)

trace.note: Set stores token under host and scope key
Do resolves host and consults cache before Credential

finding.guards_checked: Per-scheme and per-scope keys (cache.go:91-96); Login clears cache for its own client (credentials/registry.go:42). No identity component in key.

finding.claim: fromRepo in cross-repository mount is interpolated unescaped into the POST URL query and used unvalidated to build the auth scope string, allowing query and scope parameter injection when the application passes untrusted input.
finding.source: fromRepo argument to Mount, supplied by the application
finding.sink: fmt.Sprintf query string (url.go:95-98) and AppendRepositoryScope scope string (repository.go:801-803, scope.go:47-56)

trace.note: ScopeRepository joins name without escaping ':' or ','

finding.guards_checked: Reference validation applies to Resolve/FetchReference references, not fromRepo. Mount 201 path verifies digest (repository.go:817). Impact limited to caller's own credentials.

finding.claim: Credential helper suffix from the Docker config (credsStore/credHelpers) is concatenated into a binary name and executed; a suffix containing a path separator bypasses PATH lookup and runs a file relative to the working directory.
finding.source: credsStore or credHelpers value in Docker config file (or DOCKER_CONFIG)
finding.guards_checked: Server address passed on stdin, not argv (native_store.go:85); action fixed; config file written 0600 (ioutil.go:42). Suffix not validated for path separators.
